title: Mystic Slow / Lightning Scroll keep enemies in the cloud
question: Do Mystic Slow (24% on spirit damage) or Lightning Scroll (64% slow then 0.75 s stun) raise time-in-cloud enough to make duration and Escalating Exposure count?
hypothesis: H-L7: fleeing enemies stay in the 50 m cloud >=30% longer with Mystic Slow; UNSUPPORTED: bots cannot move or flee (AUTORUN: bots stand, no enemy movement op).

setup.position: mid lane, bots on a 300 u ring (inside the 40 m storm)

controls: Same position and spawn distance (enemies 3 at 300 u ring, main target 350 u)
hardreset between blocks (fresh cooldowns, no items)
Same souls/level/ability tiers (unlock 7) in every arm except the thing under test
Same bot heroes, HP keep-alive (ekeep 0.9) and resists
Arms interleaved A,B,A,B; A/A floor run first

decision.rule: UNSUPPORTED until an enemy movement op exists
